title: 第266章 认不认输！
slug: 德黑兰杂货铺我的情报明码标价
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

哈桑早就按捺不住了，大步迎上去，一巴掌重重拍在卡姆兰肩膀上。

“干得漂亮！”

随即转过头，下巴扬得老高，冲着雷子和疯子的方向嗤笑出声。

“看见没？这才是实力！”

“你们刚才不是挺能嘚瑟的吗？怎么这会儿全哑巴了？”

“连个飞盘都打不着，还不如回家抱孩子去。”

雷子本来就因为输了憋着一肚子火，听到这话，直接怒了。

“你特么放什么屁！”

他脖子上的青筋暴起，撸起袖子就往前冲。

哈桑也不甘示弱，往前顶了一步，两手一摊，满脸挑衅。

“怎么，枪打不过，还想咬人？”

雷子刚冲出两步，后领口猛地一紧。

一股大力传来，硬生生把他拽得停在原地。

杜坚沉着脸，单手死死拽着雷子的战术背心。

“给我滚回来。”

“队长！这孙子嘴太欠了！”

雷子梗着脖子，指着哈桑。

“我让你回来，听不懂？”

杜坚加重了语气。

雷子咬了咬牙，狠狠瞪了哈桑一眼。

甩开手，退回原位。

老K凑到杜坚旁边，推了推鼻梁上的眼镜，压低声音。

“队长，这帮家伙不好对付。”

“刚才那风向乱七八糟，飞盘重量又轻，完全没有规律可循。”

“他们能打中，其实靠的是长期在战场上喂出来的直觉。”

“咱们平时练的战术动作相对刻板，碰上他们这种，吃亏也是正常的。”

杜坚点了点头。

“说得没错。”

杜坚看着面前的雷子和疯子，语气平稳。

“人家再怎么说也是当年圣城旅排得上号的精锐，实战机会比咱们多不少。”

“再加上这是本就是人家的地盘，中东这边的风向、气候，他们远比咱们适应的早。”

“输给他们，也不算丢人。”

“认清差距，以后也能有个追赶的方向。”

“而且，这只是第一把。”

“没到最后，谁输谁赢还不一定。”

雷子听完，深吸了一口气，脸上的暴躁退下去不少。

杜坚见雷子好一些了，这才转过身，看着苏莱曼，坦然开口。

“苏莱曼队长，这第一项枪械比试，我们输了。”

“杜队长痛快。”

苏莱曼笑了笑，脸上的敌意少了几分。

“那咱们继续。”

杜坚解开战术背心的卡扣，随手扔给旁边的老K。

“第二项，近身格斗，怎么个比法？”

“很简单。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Hassan couldn't hold it any longer, strode forward to meet him, and slapped Kamran hard on the shoulder.

"Well done!"

Then he turned his head, raised his chin high, and sneered in the direction of Lei Zi and Madman.

"Did you see it? This is strength!"

"Weren't you quite good at singing just now? Why are you all mute now?"

"If you can't even hit a Frisbee, you might as well go home and hold your baby."

Lei Zi was already angry because of losing, but when he heard this, he became angry.

"What the hell are you farting at?"

The veins on his neck popped out, he rolled up his sleeves and rushed forward.

Not to be outdone, Hassan took a step forward, spreading his hands with a provocative look on his face.

"Why, you can't hit someone with a gun, but you still want to bite someone?"

As soon as Lei Zi took two steps forward, his back collar suddenly tightened.

A strong force came, forcefully pulling him to a stop.

Du Jian had a sullen face, holding on to Lei Zi's tactical vest with one hand.

"Get back here."

"Captain! This grandson is too talkative!"

Lei Zi frowned and pointed at Hassan.

"I asked you to come back, don't you understand?"

Du Jian emphasized his tone.

Lei Zi gritted his teeth and glared at Hassan.

Throw your hands away and return to your original position.

Old K moved closer to Du Jian, pushed up his glasses on the bridge of his nose, and lowered his voice.

"Captain, these guys are difficult to deal with."

"The wind direction just now was in a mess, the weight of the Frisbee was light, and there was no pattern at all."

"Their ability to hit is actually based on the intuition that they have been fed on the battlefield for a long time."

"The tactical movements we usually practice are relatively rigid. It is normal to suffer losses when encountering someone like them."

Du Jian nodded.

"That's right."

Du Jian looked at Lei Zi and Madman in front of him and spoke calmly.

"No matter what people say, they were among the elites of the Holy City Brigade back then. They had many more opportunities for actual combat than us."

"In addition, this is their own territory. They have adapted to the wind direction and climate in the Middle East much earlier than us."

"It's not a shame to lose to them."

"Recognize the gap and you can have a direction to catch up in the future."

"And this is just the first one."

“It’s not clear who will win until the end.”

After hearing this, Lei Zi took a deep breath, and the anger on his face receded a lot.

Seeing that Lei Zi was getting better, Du Jian turned around, looked at Suleiman, and spoke calmly.

"Captain Suleiman, we lost this first firearms competition."

"Captain Du is happy."

Suleiman smiled, the hostility on his face lessening.

"Then let's continue."

Du Jian unbuckled the tactical vest and threw it to Old K next to him.

"The second item, close combat, how do you compare it?"

"It's very simple."
